notes.title: Huge Game Update
notes.notes:
🚀 Exciting New Updates Coming to City Business Manager!
Get ready, entrepreneurs! City Business Manager is about to get even bigger and better with a massive update packed with new features, improvements, and surprises to take your city empire to the next level. Whether you're a seasoned tycoon or just starting your business journey, these updates will bring fresh challenges, more strategic depth, and endless opportunities to grow your financial dynasty.



🌆 New Features & Improvements:

✅ Dynamic City Events – Economic booms, and unexpected challenges will keep you on your toes. Adapt your strategy to thrive!

✅ Stock Shipments – You now need to order pallets of your stock for your businesses and wait for them to arrive instead of being able to have them instantly.

✅ Suppliers – Chose from 3 different suppliers to get cheaper stocking prices and have them change based off you shops ratings, ratings on shipments, and more.

✅ And So Much More...



🛠 Quality of Life Improvements:

Smoother UI/UX with better navigation and stats tracking.

Optimized performance for faster loading and fewer crashes.

New achievements, challenges, and rewards to keep the grind exciting.

Balanced economy and business mechanics based on player feedback.



📅 Coming Soon!

We’re putting the final touches on these updates, and they’ll be rolling out in phases over the next few weeks. Stay tuned for the exact release date—follow our social media and join the City Business Manager community to get the latest news!

Your city. Your empire. Your rules. 💰🏙️
